import sys
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

# Initialize Spark session
spark = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()

# Get input file path from argument (passed via Synapse pipeline)
input_path = sys.argv[1]  # e.g., abfss://container@storageaccount.dfs.core.windows.net/data/elements.csv

# Read input data (assumes CSV with headers)
df = spark.read.option("header", True).csv(input_path)

# Filter for elements that are gases (assuming a 'state' column exists)
gases_df = df.filter(df["state"] == "gas")

# Show results
gases_df.show()

# Optional: write to output (could be another ADLS path)
# gases_df.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(sys.argv[2])
